description: This file is a Perl script named 'brcmImage.pl' that functions as a replacement for brcmImagebuilder. It handles building firmware images for router devices by combining kernel and root filesystem images, adding headers, padding, and specific fixups for particular devices. The script includes command-line options for customizing the image generation process, reads input files, and outputs the assembled firmware image.

methods.name: Read_Image
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a specified file into a scalar variable.

methods.name: Padlen
methods.description: Calculates the number of padding bytes needed to align size to a multiple of block size.

methods.name: Pad
methods.description: Pads a buffer with 0xFF bytes to ensure proper alignment based on offset and block size.

methods.name: bcmImage
methods.description: Constructs a firmware image with headers, CRCs, and embedded kernel and root filesystem images.
